purpose: Prospective design stress test for the Week 24 efficacy family; a public-data portfolio planning exercise, not the protocol's sponsor-approved power calculation.
interpretation_boundary: The simulation is a portfolio design exercise and does not reproduce a sponsor protocol power calculation.

The repeated-measures generator is longitudinal and correlated, while the analysis is a prespecified Week 24 baseline-adjusted planning approximation aligned to the two-comparison multiplicity family; it is not represented as a full mmrm-package operating-characteristics engine.
Alternative effect sizes are planning assumptions, not estimates of clinical benefit from the public study.
